> **Current state (2026-10-17):** the ten paths below hold **temporary line-art placeholders** drawn in code by `draw-cliowrite-placeholder.py` (Aaron: "draw a temporary line-art icon first"), not Image Gen masters. They let the `completion-era-icons` release gate pass. This is a deliberate, temporary exception to this directory's README rule that code-drawn artwork never substitutes for a master. When Aaron's masters arrive, overwrite the files of the same name, run the command below, and delete `draw-cliowrite-placeholder.py`.

# ClioWrite masters (generated by Aaron with Image Gen)

The prompts and the admission code are in place; only these ten masters are missing. Same specification as mingwen: 1254×1254 RGBA, genuinely transparent background (not white, not a checkerboard), subject about 86% of the canvas (mingwen's masters measure an opaque extent of about 1094/1254). Generate each one on its own and place it at the path below.

| Master goes here (under `tooling/icon-generation/completion/`) | Prompt (under `prompts/`) |
| --- | --- |
| `masters/classic/clioWrite.png` | `classic/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/platinum/clioWrite.png` | `platinum/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/aqua/clioWrite.png` | `aqua/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/snow-leopard/clioWrite.png` | `snow-leopard/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/yosemite/clioWrite.png` | `yosemite/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/big-sur/clioWrite.png` | `big-sur/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/nextstep/clioWrite.png` | `nextstep/clioWrite.txt` |
| `masters/liquid-glass/clioWrite.png` | `liquid-glass/clioWrite.txt` (generate this one first) |
| `masters/liquid-glass/clioWrite-dark.png` | `liquid-glass/clioWrite-dark.txt` (edit from the one above) |
| `masters/liquid-glass/clioWrite-clear.png` | `liquid-glass/clioWrite-clear.txt` (edit from the default one) |

Once they are in place, the integrator runs:

```
npm run build:completion-icons
```

It produces each era's 16/32/64/128 tiers, writes `apps/desktop/assets/themes/completion-icon-extension.json` (the build writes the hashes; never hand-write them) and rebuilds the System 7 family. Then run `npm run verify:changed -- --base HEAD`.
